chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives the world?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Nazar al-Salih* (the good gaze), illustrating how divine perfection necessitates viewing creation through the lens of wisdom rather than defect. This principle serves as a cornerstone for Shia theological epistemology, affirming that God’s knowledge is purely positive and that apparent evils in the universe are perceived by Him as components of a greater, coherent good.
